title: BeginAuthorizationOptions
description: What starting an authorization-code grant is told: the knowledge base to sign in to, where the issuer sends the person back, and, re-authenticating, which registered knowledge base it is and what the person believed they chose.

redirectUri.description: Where the issuer sends the person back to.

kbId.description: The registered knowledge base being re-authenticated, rather than a new address connected to.

expectedDid.description: The knowledge base's DID the person believed they chose: verified after, never assumed.

expectedName.description: The knowledge base's name the person believed they chose: verified after, never assumed.
